message.content: {"version":"1","text":"The outfit is built around a dark, monochromatic base with subtle texture. You start with a charcoal kimono-style coat that drapes loosely over your frame, tied at the waist to define your shape without bulk. Beneath it, a sleek black off-shoulder top adds a soft contrast to the structured outer layer, while high-waisted trousers in a neutral tone elongate your legs and keep the silhouette balanced. A delicate milky headband with floral accents softens your face and introduces a touch of femininity that contrasts beautifully with the clean lines of the coat. The look is grounded by ginger suede ankle boots that bring warmth and movement, perfect for walking through snow-covered streets while maintaining comfort.","how_to_wear":["Wear the kimono-style coat loosely draped over your shoulders when indoors, letting it drape naturally as you move during your commute.","Keep the off-shoulder top tucked or slightly untucked depending on how much you want to show of your waistline—tucking emphasizes your defined shape while leaving it loose adds a relaxed vibe.","Tie the belt on the coat only if you’re feeling colder or want to accentuate your silhouette; otherwise, wear it open for effortless flow through the day."],"wrong_photos":[],"swap":{"item":"","why":""},"about_items":[{"n":"#119·38","text":"This dark kimono-style coat features a relaxed fit with wide sleeves and a self-tie belt that gently cinches at the waist. Its deep charcoal hue offers warmth against the cold while its soft fabric drapes beautifully over your X-shaped frame, drawing attention to your natural curves without adding bulk."},{"n":"#453·13","text":"The black off-shoulder top has a sleek ribbed texture and short sleeves that expose just enough shoulder for a feminine touch. Its simple silhouette complements the structured outer layer while keeping the outfit feeling effortless and modern."},{"n":"#170·26","text":"These trousers are cut straight with a high waist that elongates your legs and balances your proportions. Their neutral tone blends seamlessly with both the coat and top, creating a cohesive foundation for the entire ensemble."},{"n":"#151·16","text":"This black beret is adorned with delicate gold-toned embellishments that add an unexpected spark of elegance. Its slightly slouchy shape sits comfortably on your head, adding character without overwhelming your features or disrupting the outfit’s minimalist vibe."},{"n":"#543·16","text":"The milky-colored headband features intricate floral motifs with crystal centers, offering a gentle contrast to the darker tones of your coat and top. Its lightweight design rests softly against your hairline, adding refinement without drawing too much attention away from your overall look."},{"n":"#261·05","text":"These ginger suede ankle boots feature a low heel and plush lining for all-day comfort. Their warm tone contrasts subtly with the cool grays and blacks in your outfit while providing traction on snowy surfaces—perfect for navigating icy sidewalks during your morning walk to work."},{"n":"#160·03","text":"This black leather tote bag has a pebbled texture that adds depth to your outfit without competing with its other elements. Its sturdy handles allow you to carry it comfortably whether slung over one shoulder or held by the side, making it practical yet polished for your daily commute."}]}
